goal: RL-paradigm precision test: 3 cubes 0.5mm gap, pick MIDDLE without moving sides, drop in 5mm-tolerance bin. Penalty/reward signals: adjacent_cube_displacement (sides should NOT move), collision_events (gripper avoid sides), drop_precision (cube center within 5mm of bin center).
thoughts: Stress-test motion planning: gap mellan cubes är 0.5mm. cuRobo måste plan trajectory som tar middle cube WITHOUT touching sides. Tight bin (5mm tolerance) drop-precision-forcing. Penalty-driven auto-tuning.
code:
# DomeLight + Ground
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# Table
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, 0.375], scale=[1.5, 0.6, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# Franka centered
robot_wizard(robot_name="franka_panda", dest_path="/World/Franka", position=[0.0, 0, 0.75], orientation=[1.0, 0, 0, 0])

# 3 cubes i rad with 0.5mm gap. Cube size 5cm. Center at y=0.30. X-spacing: 5cm + 0.5mm = 0.0505m.
# Sides shouldn't move when middle is picked.
# Cube_L at x=-0.0505 - 0.30 = -0.3505 (50.5mm left)
# Cube_M (target) at x=-0.30 (center to pick)
# Cube_R at x=-0.3 + 0.0505 = -0.2495

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_L", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.3505, 0.30, 0.775], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_L", schema_name=api)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cube_L", attr_name="physics:mass", value=0.1)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_L", material_name="rubber")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_M", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.30, 0.30, 0.775], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_M", schema_name=api)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cube_M", attr_name="physics:mass", value=0.1)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_M", material_name="rubber")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_R", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.2495, 0.30, 0.775], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_R", schema_name=api)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cube_R", attr_name="physics:mass", value=0.1)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_R", material_name="rubber")

# Tight bin: OUTER 6.5cm, walls 5mm → INNER 5.5cm = 2.5mm tolerance per side for 5cm cube
# 2026-05-26: position IS CENTER (verified robot.py:2082-2095). But putting bin at drop_target causes EE-bin collisions during descent.
# Keep bin at (0.2675, -0.3325) so EE approaches an EMPTY column above (0.30, -0.30). NEED: change drop_target to bin-center.
create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[0.2675, -0.3325, 0.75], size=[0.065, 0.065, 0.06], wall_thickness=0.005)

# Cube_Drop + SupportPillar commented out (pickup-tuning run, 2026-05-23)
# Re-enable for drop-pose-specific work later

# Controller enabled for autonomous pickup-tuning
setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    grip_style="friction",
    belt_path=None,
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_M"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin",
    drop_target=[0.2675, -0.3325, 0.94],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Cube_L", "/World/Cube_R", "/World/Bin"],
)

penalty_signals.name: adjacent_cube_displacement
penalty_signals.description: Sum of |Cube_L final XY - initial XY| + |Cube_R final XY - initial XY|. Should be ~0.

penalty_signals.name: collision_events_non_middle
penalty_signals.description: Count of gripper-or-held-cube contacts with Cube_L/Cube_R. Should be 0.

penalty_signals.name: drop_precision_error_m
penalty_signals.description: |Cube_M final XY - bin_center XY|. Should be < 0.005.

rl_paradigm.reward_signal: Cube_M delivered AND adjacent_cube_displacement < 0.001 AND collision_events_non_middle == 0 AND drop_precision_error_m < 0.005
